description: This Java class configures Jersey for a RESTful web service within the Fineract project. It sets up features like multipart support, validation, and binds custom providers, as well as dynamically registering resource classes and providers annotated with specific annotations.

classes.name: JerseyConfig
classes.description: A Jersey configuration class for setting up REST resources, providers, and features within the Fineract infrastructure.

methods.name: JerseyConfig
methods.description: Constructor that registers features, providers, and sets configuration properties.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: PostConstruct method that dynamically registers resource and provider classes based on annotations.
